thread:
jamie: :rotating_light: Support report — multiple customers hitting 5xx / timeouts on hosted inference in eu-west since ~10:22 UTC. Error rate on /v1/generate up to ~12%. Opening war room. Can ops/infra + eng-runtime join?

incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-431 created (severity=sev2). Pager duty notified.

sophia: looking at gateway logs now — seems like a surge of upstream 502/504 from inference pods, connection resets, and a bunch of 504 timeouts at the API gateway.

sophia: snippet from logs: ```
2024-05-07T10:24:03Z gateway[nginx] upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.8.3.22, server: api.redwood, request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1"
```

drew: metrics confirm token-generation latency jumps and concurrent kvcache hits rising. GPU pod restarts in eu-west-2 around 10:20-10:25. Some OOM patterns on rw-instruct-1-large.

aj: rolling back the gateway config that deployed at 10:18 (commit abc123) — suspecting new upstream timeout tuning. Kicking rollout now.

deploy-bot: rollback started for gateway (deployment/gateway) by aj — new replicas 0 -> old config.

sophia: while rollback runs, I'm going to scale gateway + inference autoscaler to absorb burst. kubectl commands: ```kubectl scale deployment gateway --replicas=12 -n hosted-prod``` and ```kubectl set env hpa/inference HPA_MAX=40 -n hosted-prod```

maria: CS: I've patched the status page and messaged the three affected tenants with an interim update. Asking for ETA to share.

jamie: prioritize short-term mitigations: 1) rollback gateway config (aj) 2) scale gateway & inference pool (sophia/drew) 3) enable model-level fallback to rw-instruct-medium for high-latency requests (aj) 4) add temporary stricter circuit-breaker to prevent cascading failures (drew).

aj: rollback finished; new traffic started shifting back to pre-deploy config. Early signs: 502 count dropping 30% in last 2m.

drew: scaled inference pool + drained problematic pods. I'm also temporarily increasing circuit-breaker threshold to 75% (was 60%) to avoid aggressive tripping while we stabilize.

sophia: enabling fallback routing for rw-instruct-1 -> rw-instruct-medium for requests over 6s with the route rule: ```if latency>6000ms -> route model:rw-instruct-medium``` — pushing a runtime rule now.

jamie: good. keep customer comms updated. Maria, send another note at +30m if we see continued improvement.

maria: will do. Drafted message: "We are experiencing elevated 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference in eu-west. Engineers are mitigating; we’ll follow up in 30 minutes with progress and timeline."

aj: observed a pattern: a recent quantization change in model-packages triggered higher memory churn on a subset of pod shapes, leading to occasional restarts and cold starts. Reverting that for now.

incident-bot: Post-mitigation summary recorded: rollback applied, autoscale increased, fallback routing enabled, temporary circuit-breaker tuning.

jamie: current ask: confirm customer impact (how many requests affected), and whether any customers saw data loss or auth failures.

sophia: rough numbers: ~0.9% of total global traffic in the spike window, but in eu-west it was ~12% error rate. No auth errors observed — 5xx from upstream inference.

drew: no data loss reported. Retries should have been idempotent for most customers. We need to validate logs for any aborted websocket sessions.

aj: deploying a hotfix to remove the quantization tweak; rollout should finish in ~10 minutes.

10m later — sophia: hotfix rolled, memory churn dropped, restarts stopped. Error rate back to baseline (~0.4% globally, 1.2% eu-west).

jamie: OK — starting postmortem actions. We'll capture timeline and assign owners. I'm going to list action items here, please ack and tag owner if you take it.

Action items: 
- "Root cause investigation writeup" — owner: aj — due 2024-05-14. (Include verifications and exact commit causing quantization change)
- "Gateway deploy gating" — owner: sophia — due 2024-05-10. (Add stronger smoke-tests and canary with traffic patterns mimicking long generation flows)
- "SLO/alert tuning" — owner: drew — due 2024-05-09. (Adjust alert thresholds for regional spikes and add burn-rate alarm)
- "Customer communications follow-up" — owner: maria — due 2024-05-08. (Send formal post-incident note and offer support)
- "Synthetic canary for inference cold-starts" — owner: eng-devex (needs owner) — due 2024-05-12. (Create end-to-end synthetic tests for model cold starts under quantized packages)
- "Model packaging review" — owner: research/ml (needs owner) — due 2024-05-16. (Review quantization rollout process and validation)

sophia: ack for gateway deploy gating — I'll take that, sophia.

drew: ack for SLO/alert tuning.

aj: ack for root cause writeup + model packaging revert notes.

maria: ack for customer comms follow-up. I'll schedule the post-incident email after the RCA draft.

jamie: good. Two follow-ups: 1) schedule a 45m postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 PDT — invite infra, runtime, ml-packaging, and CS. 2) update runbooks with the rollback + fallback steps we used.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting created: pm-2024-05-08 16:00 UTC.

jamie: final status — stabilized, monitoring closely for next 2 hours. If error rate creeps up, we re-open the war room. Thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:

maria: sending updated customer note now.

sophia: I'll follow up with instrumentation to capture pre/post quantization mem profiles.

drew: I'll add the regional canary and update alert docs.

aj: publishing RCA draft to the incident doc and linking here when ready.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2024-431 marked as mitigated by jamie — status: monitoring.

jamie: closing thread for now; postmortem doc link will be posted here when available. Thanks all.
